title: Rainbow Mountain + 7 Ausangate Lagoons
long_description: Enjoy one of the most complete and spectacular experiences in southern Peru. This tour combines the famous Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca) with the impressive circuit of the 7 Ausangate Lagoons, a journey designed for travelers seeking adventure, unique landscapes, and an authentic connection with the Andes.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets, and a professional guide.
seo_title: Rainbow Mountain and 7 Ausangate Lagoons | 2-Day Tour from Cusco
seo_description: Discover Rainbow Mountain Vinicunca and the 7 Ausangate Lagoons circuit on a 2-day tour from Cusco. Adventure, nature, and unique Andean landscapes.
seo_keywords: rainbow mountain, vinicunca, 7 ausangate lagoons, ausangate tour, trekking cusco, adventure tours cusco, nature in cusco

days.title: Day 1 - Cusco – Rainbow Mountain – Andean Community
days.text: Early departure from Cusco (approximately 4:00 a.m.) heading south to the Ausangate Valley. Along the way, we stop for breakfast. We then continue to the starting point of the hike to Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca), following a gradual trek of approximately 1.5 to 2 hours until reaching the main viewpoint, where we will enjoy the stunning multicolored Andean landscape located at 5,036 m above sea level. Free time for photos and guide explanations. After descending, we head to enjoy a buffet lunch and then continue toward Pacchanta, where we will spend the night. Dinner and overnight stay in a rural lodge, surrounded by mountains and a unique starry sky.

days.title: Day 2 - 7 Ausangate Lagoons – Cusco
days.text: Early breakfast and departure to the 7 Ausangate Lagoons circuit, a scenic hike lasting approximately 5 to 6 hours in total. We will visit lagoons located between 4,200 and 4,800 meters above sea level, featuring intense turquoise, blue, and green colors, with privileged views of the Ausangate Snow-capped Mountain. There is an optional opportunity to enjoy hot springs. Afterward, we return to the community for lunch and then begin the journey back to Cusco, arriving approximately between 5:00 and 6:00 p.m.

technical_sheet:
RAINBOW MOUNTAIN + 7 AUSANGATE LAGOONS TOUR
• Destination: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca) and the 7 Ausangate Lagoons.
• Duration: 2 days / 1 night.
• Maximum altitude: 4,200 – 5,036 m above sea level.
• Difficulty level: Moderate – High.
• Tour type: Nature / Adventure / Trekking.
• Climate: Andean cold.
• Recommended for: Acclimatized travelers in good physical condition.
• Not recommended for: People with heart or respiratory problems.
includes:
• Tourist transportation.
• Professional guide.
• 2 breakfasts.
• 2 lunches.
• 1 dinner.
• 1 night of rural accommodation.
• Trekking poles.
• Thermal blankets.
• Oxygen and first aid kit.
not_includes:
• Sleeping bag (recommended for travelers from warm climates).
• Snacks.
• Tips.
